requirements.description: Original 1984–1998 full and relative-performance firm-year populations from the 1999 Compustat PC-Plus Active and Research files, after SIC/fiscal-year-end/assets/book-equity and data-availability screens; annual cross-sections and winsorization are part of the source design.

required_coverage.population: 15-year Table 5 full sample: 33,163 firm-years (4,810 non-Big 6; 28,353 Big 6); income-increasing/Cpoor sample 15,587 and income-decreasing/Cgood sample 17,576.
required_coverage.detail: The source initial Compustat span is 1983–1998; baseline results cover 1984–1998. Firm-year results aggregate 15 yearly fits; per-year observation counts are not reported. Raw formula/lag windows are separate from these fit years.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No coordinator coverage confirmation establishes the 1999 PC-Plus Active/Research source population, exact 15-year filtering, per-year groups, or current-data overlap.

requirements.description: Annual Compustat financial fields for total/current accrual inputs, revenue and receivables changes, PPE, CFO, assets, net income, total debt, sales, price/earnings and other baseline controls.

required_coverage.population: Eligible nonfinancial firm-years for DAC estimation, auditor-choice probits and baseline accrual-choice regressions.
required_coverage.detail: The sample begins in 1984, but current and lagged construction is nested: DAC_{t−1} in the first baseline year 1984 requires DAC for 1983, whose Eq. (2) current/lagged inputs reach raw 1982. Formula fields are legacy Compustat items; no numeric/name resemblance is treated as a verified map.

routes.coverage_notes: No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this assigned paper. Bounded probes and catalog metadata do not establish the required historical years/population/frequency.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Current Compustat live keys and a few accounting columns are present, but the legacy item mapping, 1982–1998 source values, 1999 PC-Plus vintage and eligible-firm coverage are unconfirmed.

variable_coverage.construction: Source definition: Indicator equal to one for a Big 6 audited firm and zero otherwise; COMPUSTAT auditor codes 1–8 are classified as Big 6. Formula: 1 if COMPUSTAT auditor code is 1–8; 0 otherwise.. Inputs/route requirements: r_auditor_history. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Absolute value of short-term working-capital accruals, scaled by sales. Working-capital accruals are the first two terms of the total-accruals identity. Formula: |(ΔCA−ΔCash)−(ΔCL−ΔSTD−ΔTP)|/Sales. Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Absolute value of depreciation and amortization, scaled by sales. Formula: |Dep|/Sales. Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Firm size measured by the natural logarithm of total sales, in millions of dollars. Formula: ln(total sales in millions of dollars).. Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Leverage measured by debt-to-total-assets ratio. Formula: total debt/total assets. Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Price-to-earnings ratio at fiscal year-end. Formula: fiscal-year-end price-to-earnings ratio. Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Indicator equal to one when shares outstanding increase by more than 10 percent during the current fiscal year, and zero otherwise. Formula: 1 if shares outstanding increase >10%; 0 otherwise. Inputs/route requirements: r_share_count. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Indicator equal to one when net income divided by lagged assets is negative and the absolute change in net income divided by lagged assets exceeds 10 percent; zero otherwise. Formula: 1 if NI/A_{t−1}<0 and |ΔNI/A_{t−1}|>0.10; 0 otherwise. Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Total accruals for firm j in year t, scaled by lagged total assets. Total accruals equal the change in noncash current assets less the change in operating current liabilities and depreciation and amortization. Formula: [(ΔCA−ΔCash)−(ΔCL−ΔSTD−ΔTP)−Dep]/A_{j,t−1}. Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals, r_sic_codes. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: The reciprocal of lagged total assets, included as the scaled constant term. Formula: 1/A_{j,t−1}. Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals, r_sic_codes. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Change in sales revenues less change in accounts receivable, scaled by lagged total assets. Formula: (ΔREV_{jt}−ΔAR_{jt})/A_{j,t−1}. Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals, r_sic_codes. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Property, plant, and equipment scaled by lagged total assets. Formula: PPE_{jt}/A_{j,t−1}. Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals, r_sic_codes. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Change in cash flow from operations scaled by lagged total assets. Formula: ΔCFO_{jt}/A_{j,t−1}. Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals, r_sic_codes. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Discretionary accruals, defined as the residual from equation (2), equal to actual total accruals less fitted nondiscretionary accruals. Formula: TAC/A_{t−1} − fitted value from Eq. (2). Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals, r_sic_codes. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Indicator equal to one if the firm has a Big 6 auditor and zero otherwise; COMPUSTAT auditor codes 1–8 are classified as Big 6. Source definition: Firm size measured by the natural logarithm of total assets. Formula: ln(total assets). Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals. Source definition: Operating cash flows scaled by lagged total assets in Table 5. Equation (4) prose instead says scaled by total assets without specifying lag; the table and its row definition indicate lagged assets. Formula: CFO/ A_{t−1}. Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Indicator equal to one if total shares outstanding decrease by more than 10 percent during the current fiscal year; zero otherwise. Formula: 1 if shares outstanding decrease >10%; 0 otherwise. Inputs/route requirements: r_share_count. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Indicator equal to one in the first year a new auditor starts auditing a new client firm; zero otherwise. Formula: 1 in first year with new auditor; 0 otherwise. Inputs/route requirements: r_auditor_history. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Indicator equal to one in the last year the incumbent auditor finishes auditing the client, followed by an auditor change; zero otherwise. Formula: 1 in last year with old auditor; 0 otherwise. Inputs/route requirements: r_auditor_history. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: One-period lagged discretionary accruals, where DAC is the residual from equation (2). Formula: DAC_{j,t−1}. Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals, r_sic_codes. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

Source definition: Inverse Mills ratio generated from the auditor-choice probit equation (3) and included to control for potential self-selection. The equation (4) lead-in and Table 5 note instead cite auditor-choice model (4), although equation (4) is the accrual-choice model. Formula: Inverse Mills ratio from Eq. (3). Inputs/route requirements: r_comp_fundamentals, r_auditor_history. Current source-field mapping, exact identifier linkage, or full period/population coverage remains as stated on those requirements; do not tune to reported coefficients.

design_coverage.reason: Annual fits are separate year-by-year cross-sections; the selected baseline equation does not identify fixed-effect terms. The source does not explicitly say fixed effects are absent.
No cluster variable is reported. Inference uses annual coefficient distributions/Fama–MacBeth time-series t-values; the DAC support equation reports no separate clustered error correction.
No regression weights are reported. The minimum-firm threshold and year-by-industry estimation are grouping rules, not observation weights.

Generate annual inverse Mills ratios from Eq. (3), then estimate the accrual-choice equation cross-sectionally in each year 1984–1998 for the full, Cpoor or Cgood group; report 15-year average coefficients and time-series t-values. Per-year N is not reported.

implementation_issues.description: The source population uses 1999 Compustat PC-Plus Active and Research files. Current WRDS Compustat column presence does not establish legacy item mapping, PC-Plus value equivalence, 1982–1998 coverage, or the original firm/year restrictions.

Equation (2) is fit separately for each year and two-digit SIC cell with at least 20 firms, but cell-specific sample sizes, complete group membership and all legacy Compustat item mappings are not provided by the current probe.

NewAud and OldAud require a continuous historical client-auditor sequence. OldAud also needs a subsequent auditor change; the source data span ends in 1998 while the final 1998 row may require a 1999 transition. Historical code #149 meaning and transition coverage remain unresolved.

CFO scaling differs across source passages: Table 5 and the frozen variable definition show lagged total assets, while equation (4) prose says total assets without specifying a lag. Assessment/audit retain the Table 5 lagged-assets scale and document the conflict.

Lambda is defined in the model prose as the inverse Mills ratio from the auditor-choice probit Eq. (3), but the accrual-choice lead-in/Table 5 note also refers to model (4), which is the second-stage accrual model. Preserve the source-supported Eq. (3) construction and flag the contradictory reference.

Annual coefficients and t-statistics use 15 yearly cross-sections. Exact second-stage estimator and any additional serial-correlation adjustment beyond the stated time-series/Fama–MacBeth variation should follow the original table/text; per-year N is not reported.

review_notes: No local historical/population coverage confirmations were supplied. Bounded Compustat probes verify current fields only; they do not verify 1999 PC-Plus item meanings or full source-period sample coverage.

implementation_issues.description: The source population uses 1999 Compustat PC-Plus Active and Research files. Current WRDS Compustat column presence does not establish legacy item mapping, PC-Plus value equivalence, 1982–1998 coverage, or the original firm/year restrictions.

Equation (2) is fit separately for each year and two-digit SIC cell with at least 20 firms, but cell-specific sample sizes, complete group membership and all legacy Compustat item mappings are not provided by the current probe.

NewAud and OldAud require a continuous historical client-auditor sequence. OldAud also needs a subsequent auditor change; the source data span ends in 1998 while the final 1998 row may require a 1999 transition. Historical code #149 meaning and transition coverage remain unresolved.

CFO scaling differs across source passages: Table 5 and the frozen variable definition show lagged total assets, while equation (4) prose says total assets without specifying a lag. Assessment/audit retain the Table 5 lagged-assets scale and document the conflict.

Lambda is defined in the model prose as the inverse Mills ratio from the auditor-choice probit Eq. (3), but the accrual-choice lead-in/Table 5 note also refers to model (4), which is the second-stage accrual model. Preserve the source-supported Eq. (3) construction and flag the contradictory reference.

Annual coefficients and t-statistics use 15 yearly cross-sections. Exact second-stage estimator and any additional serial-correlation adjustment beyond the stated time-series/Fama–MacBeth variation should follow the original table/text; per-year N is not reported.
